Title: The Jesus Prayer
Subtitle: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of God
IntroText: The Jesus Prayer is an ancient Christian contemplative prayer rooted in the Eastern tradition. It calls on the Holy Name of Jesus and asks for His mercy.

Blocks.Text: have mercy on me, a sinner.

This short prayer can be repeated many times in rhythm with breathing — inhaling on "Lord Jesus Christ, Son of God" and exhaling on "have mercy on me, a sinner." It is a form of continuous prayer, keeping the heart focused on God throughout the day.
